description: A new project's gate carries only steps it can pass on the first run; every deferred step is named in its AGENTS.md with the line to add
steps: pnpm exec jest --config jest.config.cjs scripts/__tests__/harness-init.spec.ts — "the steps a project gets", "the gate it writes" and "tells the new project which steps are missing" pass
node bin/harness.mjs init --yes --name probe --database --api --web --into /tmp/probe — the output names three deferred steps and six in the gate
the generate job in CI: five variants scaffolded, installed and gated on every push, all green on the pull request that closes this entry

description: Every package the manifest names resolves to a version from package.json or harness.versions.json, and no name has a version in both
steps: pnpm exec jest --config jest.config.cjs scripts/__tests__/harness-package.spec.ts — "the versions it can give a new project" passes: every name resolves, no overlap, nothing the manifest does not name

pnpm exec jest --config jest.config.cjs scripts/__tests__/harness-init.spec.ts — "refuses to resolve a package this repository does not have" and "takes the app versions from harness.versions.json" pass

description: The tarball carries every file the manifest says travels and no guard suite, no workflow of this repository alone, and nothing git ignores
steps: pnpm exec jest --config jest.config.cjs scripts/__tests__/harness-package.spec.ts — "what the tarball carries" passes, asked of npm pack --dry-run --json
npm pack --dry-run — no path under scripts/__tests__, no generate.yml or release.yml, no .work-budget.json

description: A copied core script contains none of the identifiers of the product the harness was written in
steps: pnpm exec jest --config jest.config.cjs scripts/__tests__/harness-boundary.spec.ts — "core names nothing about this product" passes for every core script, and the word list is proved live against the manifest

description: A commit on a tree no recorded green run covers, or after a session edit to a protected file, is refused
steps: pnpm exec jest --config jest.config.cjs scripts/__tests__/commit-gate.spec.ts — every case passes: no receipt, a failed receipt, a receipt for another tree, each shape of git commit, each protected path, the interpreter heredoc
in a session: edit a file, run git commit without ./verify.sh — the hook prints BLOCKED and cites I11

description: feature_list.json accepts only its four legal edits and one closure per commit, and verify-log.jsonl keeps every line, red runs included
steps: pnpm exec jest --config jest.config.cjs scripts/__tests__/feature-list.spec.ts — every adversarial case passes
pnpm exec jest --config jest.config.cjs scripts/__tests__/verify-log.spec.ts — deletions, rewrites, an emptied file, malformed lines and a backdated run are each refused

retracted.reason: the record it names, verify-log.jsonl, is a directory of one file per run since 2026-09-12; the guarantee moves to #7, worded for the directory

description: Every script the harness ships is type-checked as it runs, under tsc -b with no build step, here and in a generated project
steps: ./verify.sh — step 02 exits 0 with tsconfig.scripts.json referenced from tsconfig.build.json and every scripts/*.mjs and bin/*.mjs carrying // @ts-check
pnpm exec jest --config jest.config.cjs scripts/__tests__/harness-init.spec.ts — "typechecks the copied scripts, so their @ts-check is not decoration" passes

description: feature_list.json accepts only its four legal edits and one closure per commit, and verify-log/ keeps every run as a file that is never edited or removed, red runs included, with no conflict between branches
steps: pnpm exec jest --config jest.config.cjs scripts/__tests__/feature-list.spec.ts — every adversarial case passes

pnpm exec jest --config jest.config.cjs scripts/__tests__/verify-log.spec.ts — a removed, rewritten, emptied, malformed or stray run is refused, and two branches that both recorded runs merge without a conflict

description: Every audit verdict is kept under audit-log/, one tracked file per audit, never edited or removed; a commit that closes an entry carries a READY audit of its own tree under that entry's contract, and CI refuses one that does not
steps: run /verify-task <spec> on a tree; a file named after the moment appears under audit-log/ with the verdict, the contract and the tree hash, whatever the verdict was
edit or remove a file under audit-log/, or put a file there that is not an audit; the commit gate refuses the commit and step 07's neighbour, audit-log.mjs check, names the file
commit a flip of passes to true without the audit file, then run check-feature-list.mjs --at <that commit> --base <its parent>; it refuses, naming the entry and the missing audit
the same with the READY audit of that tree in the commit; it passes; with a NOT_READY audit, or an audit of another tree or another contract, it refuses
audit-log.mjs tree HEAD equals verify-receipt.mjs hash on a clean checkout, so the recomputation CI relies on is the one the receipt made

description: A journal entry's Evidence names a run under verify-log/ and, when the entry closed a feature, the READY audit under audit-log/; the stop hook, step 03 and CI's walk refuse an entry a reader cannot follow
steps: write an entry whose Evidence says "the log" and run node scripts/progress.mjs check; it refuses, naming the entry
name a verify-log/<id> that exists; it passes; name one that does not; it refuses with the id
write closed #n in Feature with no audit-log/<id>, or one that said NOT_READY; it refuses; name the READY one; it passes
commit an entry and run progress.mjs check --at HEAD --base HEAD^; the commit's own journal and records are what is read
end a session that committed with such an entry; the stop hook refuses once with the two tail commands that print the ids

description: A branch under spike/ is asked for no receipt at commit time and no journal entry at session end, is refused as a pull request by check-pr-ready and by CI's attest job, and keeps the protected files protected; the generator ships the rule
steps: git checkout -b spike/anything, edit, stage; a commit goes through with no receipt and stderr says the branch is a spike
edit verify.sh on the spike; the protected-file rule refuses as on any branch
end a session that committed on the spike with no PROGRESS.md entry; the stop hook is silent
start a session on the spike; the ritual prints what a spike is under the branch line
node scripts/check-pr-ready.mjs on the spike refuses with the sentence; node scripts/spike.mjs check --branch spike/x exits 3 with the same one
node scripts/harness-init.mjs --yes into a folder; scripts/spike.mjs is copied and AGENTS.md names the rule
